name: CJS Super Hornet Community Mod
summary: Free F/A-18E/F and EA-18G Super Hornet mod built on the official DCS F/A-18C Hornet.
description:
Chiller Juice Studios' mod adding F/A-18E, F/A-18F and EA-18G slots based on the DCS F/A-18C systems. Requires the F/A-18C module; it installs into the main DCS folder, replaces some Hornet files and breaks the integrity check (OVGME compatible).

Requires: Overwrites files in the DCS install directory (not Saved Games); breaks integrity check / multiplayer IC.
